title: generic arguments are inferred from the selected constructor
purpose: Each constructor that fits the call infers the specialization; a fixed one is tried before the variadic one.

provenance.origin: authored for typed and variadic overloads
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.3: Box(1) is the fixed constructor with T = int; Box("a", "b") infers T = string from the tail; Box() takes T from the expected type.
